name: Crypto Blockchain Industries
summary: Based in Paris, France, Crypto Blockchain Industries is an entity deeply involved in the blockchain sector, actively developing, operating, and making strategic investments. The company focuses on blockchain-powered applications across various industries, including video games and business solutions. A significant project currently underway is the creation of AlphaVerse, an expansive virtual world or metaverse built on blockchain technology. Its operations and investments also encompass non-fungible tokens (NFTs) and cryptocurrencies.
